senses.definition: A long roll of paper or leather with writing or pictures on it.

examples.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient scroll inside the dark cave.

senses.vi: cuộn giấy; cuộn sách

thesaurus.definition: a round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)
a document that can be rolled up (as for storage)

vi_block: Cuộn giấy, cuộn da lừa, cuộn sách, cuộc câu đối; (từ cổ, nghĩa cổ) bảng danh sách.

wiktionary.gloss: A roll of paper or parchment; a writing formed into a roll.
An ornament formed of undulations giving off spirals or sprays, usually suggestive of plant form. Roman architectural ornament is largely of some scroll pattern.
Spirals or sprays in the shape of an actual plant.
A mark or flourish added to a person's signature, intended to represent a seal, and in some States allowed as a substitute for a seal. [U.S.] Alexander Mansfield Burrill.
The carved end of a violin, viola, cello or other stringed instrument, most commonly scroll-shaped but occasionally in the form of a human or animal head.
A skew surface.

examples: I ordered a glass of lemonade and a coffee scroll.
wiktionary.gloss: A kind of sweet roll baked in a somewhat spiral shape.
The incremental movement of graphics on a screen, removing one portion to show the next.
A spiral waterway placed round a turbine to regulate the flow.
A turbinate bone.

examples: I gave the terms and conditions a quick scroll before signing up to the website.
wiktionary.gloss: The act of scrolling.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English scrowle, scrolle, from earlier scrowe, scrouwe (influenced by Middle English rolle), from Old French escroe, escrowe, escrouwe (“scroll, strip of parchment”), from Frankish *skrōda (“a shred”), from Proto-Germanic *skraudō, from *skrew- (“to cut; cutting tool”), extension of *(s)ker- (“to cut”). Doublet of shred and escrow.

senses.definition: To move information up, down, or sideways on a computer or phone screen.

examples.en: You can scroll down the page to read the rest of the article.
examples.vi: Bạn có thể cuộn xuống trang để đọc phần còn lại của bài báo.

senses.vi: cuộn màn hình; lướt màn hình

senses.definition: To spend time looking through posts, videos, or photos on a phone app.

examples.en: I spent an hour scrolling on TikTok before going to bed.
examples.vi: Tôi đã dành một tiếng lướt TikTok trước khi đi ngủ.

senses.vi: lướt mạng; lướt mạng xã hội

thesaurus.definition: move through text or graphics in order to display parts that do not fit on the screen

examples: She scrolled the offending image out of view.

wiktionary.gloss: To change one's view of data on a computer's display by moving in gradual increments, typically using an input device or touch screen.

examples: The rising credits slowly scrolled off the screen.
wiktionary.gloss: To move in or out of view horizontally or vertically.
To continuously and aimlessly consume content on social media, especially on websites or apps with a scrolling feed, such as Instagram, TikTok, or X.

examples: Hey, stop scrolling!
wiktionary.gloss: To flood a chat system with numerous lines of text, causing legitimate messages to scroll out of view before they can be read.
